name: ordinary-check-with-consequence
use_when: An authorized action is uncertain or costly.
procedure: Resolve; inspect the result; batch only supported effects in one apply; deliver. Exit on needs, choice, material, authorization or active-session divergence.

name: direct-authorized-change
use_when: An authorized world change is uncontested.
procedure: Skip resolve; batch entailed effects in one apply; deliver. Never infer consent to undisclosed costs, choices or hidden consequences.

name: repair-named-gap
use_when: A tool refused with a named gap.
procedure: Follow retryable, next, fix and closed choices; repair only that gap and retry only if permitted. Stop on action_not_authorized, admission_unavailable or stop.
